scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @yacht/shared && npm run dev -w @yacht/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @yacht/shared && npm run dev -w @yacht/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @yacht/shared && npm run build -w @yacht/client && npm run build -w @yacht/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @yacht/shared && npm run typecheck -w @yacht/client && npm run typecheck -w @yacht/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @yacht/shared && npm run build -w @yacht/server && node --test shared/test/*.test.mjs server/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:client
